_generated_from: Horizon GET /contracts/{contract_id} — Soroban Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) reporting fields
_description: Golden fixtures for SAC contract metadata responses. A SAC is a Soroban contract that issues an asset, so its issuer is a C-address and its balances are never exposed as classic Horizon trustlines. TrustBridge reads the SAC name/symbol/decimals reporting fields so a C-address issuer can be validated contract-aware instead of being rejected as a malformed G-address. Regenerate with scripts/regen-soroban-fixture.sh when the node/ABI shape changes.
_contract_fn: name() -> String, symbol() -> String, decimals() -> U32

sac_with_reporting_fields._description: Node reports the SAC reporting fields inline (newer Horizon / Soroban RPC ledger-entry shape). symbol() must match asset_code USDC.

sac_reporting_fields_string_decimals._description: Some nodes report decimals as a string and omit the nested sac object — the parser must coerce and still verify the symbol.
sac_reporting_fields_string_decimals.name: USD Coin

sac_without_reporting_fields._description: Older node exposes contract code but not the SAC reporting fields — exists is true, symbolVerified is false and the asset code check is inconclusive.
sac_without_reporting_fields.creator: GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAWHF

sac_symbol_mismatch._description: The contract reports a different symbol than the configured asset_code — a real misconfiguration that must fail the asset-code check.

not_found._description: HTTP 404 body — older testnet nodes without the Soroban contracts endpoint answer with an empty problem document.
not_found.title: Resource Missing
not_found.detail: The resource requested could not be found.

error_envelope._description: JSON-RPC error envelope — must resolve to exists=false, never throw.

malformed_contract_id._description: Not a valid C-address (too short / wrong version prefix) — fetch is refused before any network call.
